THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompaniesthis order exists between,
Mr. A. S. M. Rodrigo, No. 72/4A, Weera Mawatha, Depanama, Pannipitiya, of the one part
and
Tea Small Holdings Development Authority, No. 70, Parliament Road, Pelawatta, Battaramulla, of the other part

NOW THEREFORE I Wijeyadasa Rajapaksha, Minister of Justice and Labour Relations do by virtue of the powers vested in me bySection 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended byAct Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes (Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968) hereby appointMr. S. Kariyawasam, No. 28, Abeyratne Mawatha, Boralesgamuwa to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlementby arbitration.
WIJEYADASA RAJAPAKSHA,Minister of Justice and Labour Relations.
Colombo.12th March, 2015.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. A. S. M. Rodrigo, No. 72/4A, Weera Mawatha, Depanama, Pannipitiya, of the one part
and
Tea Small Holdings Development Authority, No. 70, Parliament Road, Pelawatta, Battaramulla, of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. A. S. M. Rodrigo, working as a Tea Inspector of the Kegalle Regional Office of the Tea Small Holdings Development Authorityhas been caused injustice by the punishments imposed after the disciplinary inquiry held against him and if so to what reliefs he is entitled.
HERATH YAPA,Commissioner of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo, this 04th day of March, 2015.

01. Mr. E. Hettiarachchi, No. 329, Alagalla Terrace, Kadugannawa.02. Mr. R. M. Dhanapala, No. 646/A, Ududeniya Road, Meeruppa, Marassana.03. Mr. M. R. R. M. S. Peiris, No. 554, Wewala Church Road, Weligampitiya, Ja-Ela, of the one part
and
Sri Lanka Transport Board, No. 200, Kirula Road, Colombo 05, of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether the cut down of salaries earned by Mr. E. Hettiarachchi, as the Managing Director of the Rajarata Bus Company Limited, Mr. R.M. Dhanapala, as the Finance Director of the Rajarata Bus Company Limited, and Mr. M. R. R. M. S. Peiris, as the Director (Engineering)of the Gampaha Bus Company Limited, by the employer, Sri Lanka Transport Board after they had been removed from those posts bythe Secretary to the Treasury is just and if not so, to what reliefs each of them is entitled.
HERATH YAPA,Commissioner of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo, this 23rd day of February, 2015.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Lanka Estates Staffs' Union, No. 06, Aloe Avenue, Colombo 03 (on behalf of Mr. Anura Wasantha Adihetti), of the one part
and
Rekadahena Plantation (Private) Limited, Rekadahena, Kahaduwa, of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. Anura Wasantha Adihetti working as a Field Officer at present in the Motakanda Estate under Rekadahena Plantation (Private)Limited had been caused injustice by the official residence which had been provided to him while he was working at the Rekadahena Estateof the same Company being taken back without the payment of any alternative allowance, and if so to what reliefs he is entitled.
